imageCredits.title: People waiting for the rain and dancing
Rain pouring as farmers plough their fields
Peacock dances happily as rains fill up the lakes, rivers and streams
People walking and carrying logs of wood on their heads
People cutting down the trees and trucks taking the them
People reconstructing a village into a town
Rivers drying up and hills disappearing
Anguished farmers waiting for the rain
A village gradually reviving with lush fields and vegetation
A village settlement by the hill
